//: This is the microservice that downloads animal pictures, saves them in
the database and hands them back out over a REST API.
Commands (run from this folder, or from the root with 'npm run <name> -w api'):
npm run dev      start the API on your machine and restart it on every code change
npm run build    compile the TypeScript in src/ to JavaScript in dist/
npm start        run the compiled JavaScript (this is what Docker does)
npm test         run the unit tests once (fast, no database needed)
npm run test:integration  run the integration tests against a real database (needs Docker)
npm run typecheck  check the types without producing files
name: animal-picture-api
description: REST API that downloads random animal pictures, stores them in PostgreSQL and serves the latest one.
